newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy, corn, wheat unchanged.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy, corn, wheat unchanged.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean, corn and wheat values were unchanged Thursday in quiet dealings, exporters said.
"There's just not a thing going on," said one source.

Some pinpointed weather as a potential source of weakness in the market. Warmer temperatures in the U.S. Midwest have melted ice on the Mississippi River and increased the flow of barge traffic and grain movement, cash dealers said.
Some U.S. exporters also noted with minor concern China's re-entry into the world market as an exporter of corn.

A U.S. Department of Agriculture official said Thursday that China has exported up to 300,000 tonnes of corn this week to Asian countries, and private sources have reported heavy Chinese sales this week.
